## Project overview

This project explores associations between HEXACO personality traits
and teamwork quality using questionnaire data.

It also includes a Shiny app for exploring observed relationships and
simulating hypothetical team-formation strategies. Simulated outcomes
reflect assumptions, not proven effects on real teams.

## Data and scoring

The dataset contains 54 respondents and includes personality and
teamwork-quality questionnaire items.

The scoring rules and treatment of missing responses must be checked
against the study documentation before interpreting results.

## Statistical analysis

The analysis below examines the association between agreeableness
and reported communication quality.

```{r analysis}
source("data_processing.R")     # GIVES ERROR 
#                            Warning in file(file, "rt") :
#                            cannot open file 'data/HEXACO_TWQ_raw-data.csv': No such file or directory
#                            Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
summary(model)
print(communication_plot)
```

This analysis is exploratory. The model does not account for
participants belonging to the same team, and the variables were
selected after examining correlations.


## Simulation

The simulation generates hypothetical HEXACO profiles and teamwork-quality
outcomes under different team-formation strategies. Its parameters are
assumptions for exploration, not estimates of causal effects.

The shared `simulation_core.R` file is in the project root. The standalone
`data_simulation.R` script uses that shared logic and writes generated files
to the simulation output folder.

To generate the simulated data, run this chunk manually when needed. It is
not run when knitting this report.

```{r generate-simulated-data, eval=FALSE}
source("data_simulation.R")
```

## Interactive app

The Shiny app provides controls for exploring the observed data and
comparing simulated team-formation strategies. To launch it from the project
root, run:

```{r launch-app, eval=FALSE}
shiny::runApp("Shiny_App.R")
```

The app uses `simulation_core.R` for shared simulation calculations. The
`data_simulation_copy.R` file is a copy; `data_simulation.R` is the script
documented here as the main simulation script.

## Project files

- `data/` — questionnaire data files.
- `figures/` — project figures.
- `src/` — analysis code and other source files.
- `Shiny_App.R` — interactive Shiny app.
- `data_simulation.R` — standalone data simulation script.
- `simulation_core.R` — shared simulation functions.
- `main.Rmd` — this report.

## Limitations

The observed sample is small, and participants belong to existing teams.
Analyses should account for that grouping where appropriate. Observed
associations do not establish causation. Simulated results depend on the
assumptions and settings selected in the simulation.
